newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Central Bank launches "Baibor" rate.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Central Bank launches "Baibor" rate.

text.p: Argentina's Central Bank said Monday it was launching an average reference interest rate for prime interbank loans, in dollars and pesos, called "Baibor."

The Baibor will be updated on a daily basis and is the local equivalent of the Libor rate, said a Central Bank spokesman. It will vary according to terms of between 1-545 days for peso loans and 1-730 days for dollar loans.
The Baibor on Monday was set at 6.1875 percent for one-day loans both in pesos and dollars, 9.0 percent for 545-day peso-denominated loans and 8.4375 percent for 730-day dollar-denominated loans.
